packages.name: General Simple Guided Prayer
packages.description: A gentle, ecumenical prayer session: pause, confess, give thanks, listen, intercede, and close with the Lord's Prayer.
packages.author: Theodia

packages.name: Peace and Rest
packages.description: A guided session to release anxiety, receive God's peace, and rest in stillness before sleep or a stressful moment.
packages.author: Theodia

packages.name: Catholic Guided Prayer
packages.description: Sign of the Cross, Our Father, Hail Mary, Glory Be, brief examen, and intercession.
packages.author: Theodia

packages.name: Protestant Guided Prayer
packages.description: Scripture-centered session with confession, thanksgiving, listening, intercession, the Lord's Prayer, and a doxology.
packages.author: Theodia

packages.name: Orthodox Guided Prayer
packages.description: Trisagion, Jesus Prayer, stillness before icons in the heart, intercession, and blessing.
packages.author: Theodia

packages.name: Jewish Guided Prayer
packages.description: Shema, blessings, reflection on the day, and personal supplication.
packages.author: Theodia

packages.name: Faith in God's Faithfulness
packages.description: A guided meditation on Habakkuk 2:4 — the just live by faith — with verses that encourage trust in God's steadfast love and faithfulness.
packages.author: Theodia

packages.name: Go and Make Disciples
packages.description: A guided prayer on Matthew 28:18-20 and Luke 15:7 — an encouraging call to the Great Commission, the joy of sharing faith, and courage to step into the world with Christ.
packages.author: Theodia

packages.name: Pray for Leaders
packages.description: A guided prayer for leaders in every sphere of life, grounded in 1 Timothy 2:1-2 — asking for peace, dignity, and wisdom for those in authority.
packages.author: Theodia

packages.name: Pray for the Peace of Jerusalem
packages.description: A guided prayer for Jerusalem and all its people, rooted in Psalm 122:6 — asking for peace, security, and flourishing for the city sacred to three faiths.
packages.author: Theodia

packages.name: Pray for the Persecuted Church
packages.description: A guided prayer for Christians facing persecution around the world, grounded in Hebrews 13:3 and Matthew 5:44, with promises of courage from Isaiah 41:10 and Romans 8:38-39.
packages.author: Theodia

packages.name: Create in Me a Clean Heart
packages.description: A guided prayer for the removal of hidden sins and the renewal of the inner life, rooted in Psalm 51:10 — asking God to create a clean heart and a steadfast spirit.
packages.author: Theodia

packages.name: Love and Forgive Our Enemies
packages.description: A guided prayer for the hard work of loving and forgiving enemies, grounded in Matthew 5:44 — pray for those who persecute you — and the freedom that forgiveness brings.
packages.author: Theodia
